hooks.name: Accessibility Review
hooks.description: When a component changes, audit it against WCAG 2.1 AA and report violations.

action.prompt: A component changed. Audit it for WCAG 2.1 AA issues: semantic elements, ARIA correctness, keyboard operability, focus management, color-contrast risks, and alt text. Report concrete violations with the exact fix. Only apply low-risk, obviously-correct fixes.
